Ian Szabo  
Bengaluru, India | +91 98765 43210 | ian.szabo@email.com | linkedin.com/in/ianszabo  

A results-oriented technologist with 3 years of experience shaping scalable backend systems and leading cross-functional teams in enterprise environments. Specialized in designing resilient architectures, optimizing cloud infrastructure, and fostering collaboration across engineering and product teams. Proven ability to balance technical rigor with business priorities, delivering solutions that align with long-term strategic goals.  

At NexaCorp, I led a team of 5 engineers to refactor a monolithic backend service into a microservices architecture, reducing deployment time by 40% and improving system uptime to 99.95%. This work involved designing API gateways, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with DevOps to optimize cloud costs. I also spearheaded the migration of legacy systems to containerized environments, which enabled seamless integration with third-party SaaS tools and reduced maintenance overhead. My focus on technical debt management ensured the team could sustain rapid feature development without compromising code quality.  

Previously, as a Senior Backend Developer at Aurora Systems, I architected a real-time data processing pipeline that handled 10M+ requests daily. This required designing distributed systems with Kafka and Redis, while ensuring compliance with strict latency SLAs. I worked closely with stakeholders to align technical decisions with business needs, resulting in a 30% reduction in operational costs through cloud cost optimization strategies. My role also involved mentoring junior developers, which strengthened team cohesion and accelerated onboarding for new hires.  

In my role as a Junior Backend Developer, I contributed to the development of a customer analytics dashboard using Python and Node.js, which became a key tool for product teams. This project introduced automated testing frameworks and established baseline performance metrics, setting the foundation for future scalability.  

Outside of work, I’ve focused on projects that blend technical challenge with real-world impact. One such effort involved building a cost-optimization tool for cloud infrastructure, which I open-sourced and gained traction within the DevOps community. Another project, a collaborative effort with a local startup, involved designing a scalable API for a healthcare platform, emphasizing security and compliance with HIPAA standards. These projects reinforced my ability to bridge theoretical concepts with practical applications.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science  
University of Toronto | 2021  

Languages: English (near-native), Hindi (fluent)  
Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (2023), Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (2022)  

Agile/Scrum: Shaped sprint planning and retrospectives at NexaCorp, ensuring alignment between technical roadmaps and business objectives.  
Cross-team collaboration: Mediated between product and engineering teams at Aurora Systems to resolve conflicting priorities, resulting in a 25% improvement in feature delivery timelines.  
System design: Led architecture reviews for three major projects, incorporating feedback from stakeholders to refine technical approaches and mitigate risks.  
Team leadership: Mentored 3 junior engineers at NexaCorp, contributing to a 50% reduction in onboarding time and improved code quality metrics.  
Stakeholder communication: Presented technical trade-offs to non-technical leadership at Aurora Systems, securing budget approvals for critical infrastructure upgrades.  
Cloud cost optimization: Implemented tools to monitor and reduce idle EC2 instances, saving $15K annually at NexaCorp.  
Terraform: Automated infrastructure provisioning for multiple environments, reducing manual configuration errors by 60%.  
Technical debt management: Prioritized refactoring efforts that addressed 80% of critical technical debt in a legacy system, improving maintainability.
